title: 页表大小计算：单级 vs 两级页表的空间收益
expected_output:
=== given ===
logical address bits = 32, page size = 4096 B, PTE = 4 B
=== derived ===
page offset bits   = log2(4096) = 12
page number bits   = 32 - 12 = 20
number of PTEs     = 2^20 = 1048576
single-level PT    = 1048576 * 4 B = 4194304 B = 4096 KB
=== two-level ===
split VPN into L1(10 bits) + L2(10 bits)
page directory     = 2^10 = 1024 entries = 4096 B (= 1 page)
each L2 table      = 2^10 = 1024 entries = 4096 B
if a process uses k L2 tables, resident PT = 4096 B + k*4096 B
  k=1 -> 8192 B, saved 99.8047% vs single-level
  k=2 -> 12288 B, saved 99.7070% vs single-level
  k=3 -> 16384 B, saved 99.6094% vs single-level
cost: 2 page-table walks + 1 data access = 3 memory accesses without TLB
